criteria.description: Primary mega disclosure and mobile toggle reach closed, open, navigation-open, and nested-open states via selector-driven interactions on [data-rml-root]
Exactly one primary links tree (#rml-primary-links / ul.ren-nav-links) serves desktop and mobile — no duplicated responsive branches
Exactly four direct children of #rml-primary-links (> li count === 4): three ordinary ren-nav-link destinations plus one mega details/summary trigger
Exactly one visible mega chevron (.rml-chevron); classless summary::after must be neutralized
Open panel exposes exactly 3 groups × 4 destinations = 12 .rml-dest anchors with titles, 12 .rml-dest-desc descriptions, and 12 square .rml-dest-icon containers; no featured/raster media region
Contrast link rail (.rml-rail) contains exactly one .rml-rail-heading and five .rml-rail-link anchors; rail is not a nested nav landmark
Mega summary shares the centerY axis with peer primary links within 2px
Desktop panel sits under the bar (absolute); mobile panel stays in-flow; no horizontal overflow on html

At 834px (desktop shell, no hamburger): readable groups with visible descriptions and a distinct contrast rail; avoid unreadable three-column + edge-rail squeeze. At ≥64rem restore three-column primary groups + narrower edge-continued rail.
On wide desktop, rail is visibly narrower than the primary groups region and uses a distinct contrast surface; hierarchy remains recognizable even if exact 14rem source max-width adapts to tokens
Mobile primary rows are full-width and start-aligned without nested-card details chrome; mega groups compact; descriptions visually hidden; rail links stacked
Summary opens by click/Enter/Space; Escape closes and restores focus to SUMMARY

Desktop (≥48rem) pointer hover may preview-open the mega disclosure; first click pins open; second click closes; pointer remains open when moving from summary into the panel (stable close region); leaving the disclosure+panel hit region closes unpinned hover-preview. Hover is additive to click/Enter/Space, not a replacement. State and ARIA/open remain synchronized.
With JavaScript disabled on mobile, the single tree, twelve destinations, and five rail links remain usable via native disclosure
Visible interactive targets inside [data-rml-root] meet 44×44 in a touch context
prefers-reduced-motion disables block-local transitions and animations on panel/chevron/dest/rail
Link-rail mega menu preview passes axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA
Light and dark surfaces resolve through RenDS semantic tokens
Destination icons use ren-icon wrappers without inline SVG width/height attributes; destination icon containers are square
Exactly one nav.ren-nav landmark inside [data-rml-root]; rail and mega do not introduce nested unlabeled nav
Link-rail suite adopts expectSingleVisibleAffordance, expectAligned, expectWidthRatio, expectNoOverflow, and inspectNativeChrome without dropping block-specific assertions

render-matrix.json declares 10+ states with selector actions (including hover for desktop-light-hover-open) and expectedMarkers for 12 dest / 12 desc / 12 icons / 3 groups / 1 chevron / 1 rail / 1 rail heading / 5 rail links; tablet-light-open at 834px is a desktop-shell mega open without .ren-nav-toggle
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief and cascade map
